\[
I_{\text{out}}(x,y) = \max\,\{\, I(x+i,\, y+j) \;:\; -r \le i \le r,\; -r \le j \le r \,\},
\qquad
r = (3 - 1) / 2
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(I\): Input channel value
- \(I_{\text{out}}\): Output channel value
- \((x, y)\): Pixel position
- \(r\): Window radius in pixels

The output is the largest value in the window. It is the last value of the sorted window, so it is the rank-order filter with the highest rank. It is also gray dilation with a flat square structuring element.
